```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
```

# Load merged gt

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master.gt"))
unique(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
```

# Check loci order 

```{r}
is_loci_table_ordered(malagasy_merged)
```

# Impute

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_impute_simple(malagasy_merged)
```


#LD clumping

Linked loci are removed through LD clumping, (r2 > 0.5, window size = 50Kb).

```{r}
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(malagasy_merged, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
```

# Reorder

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_order_loci(malagasy_merged, use_current_table = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
# save
gt_save(malagasy_merged, quiet = TRUE)
malagasy_merged <- gt_load("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt")
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chromosome)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_merged)$chr_int)$values
# reload
```


# Update the backingfile and save the gt

loci are ordered and some have been removed through LD, backingfiles should be updated to reflect this.

```{r}
#This step avoids error in gt_roh_window where the .gt and .fbm have different numbers of rows.
#malagasy_merged <- gt_update_backingfile(malagasy_merged)
#gt_save(malagasy_merged)
#malagasy_merged <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
```

```{r}

show_loci(malagasy_merged)$genetic_dist <- 0
gt_update_backingfile(malagasy_merged)

```


# Write cleaned version out to a plink file

This file can be used for FIS through plink. 

```{r}
gt_as_plink(malagasy_merged,"/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_all_clean", type = "bed", overwrite = TRUE, chromosomes_as_int = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# subset malagasy merged down to two chromosomes
malagasy_merged_ch <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci_if(loci_chromosomes(genotypes) %in% c(1,2))
gt_as_plink(malagasy_merged_ch,"/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_chrom_1_2", type = "bed", overwrite = TRUE, chromosomes_as_int = TRUE)

```



# Read back into gen_tibble to check order

```{r}
malagasy_from_plink <- gen_tibble("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_all_clean.bed")
```

```{r}
malagasy_from_plink <- gt_load("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_all_clean.gt")
```

```{r}

rle(show_loci(malagasy_from_plink)$chromosome)$values
rle(show_loci(malagasy_from_plink)$chr_int)$values

```


```{r}
# read in the .bim file using read.table
bim <- read.table("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Malagasy_all_clean.bim", header = FALSE)

unique(bim$V1)
rle(bim$V1)$values

is.integer(bim$V1)
is.numeric(bim$V1)
all(bim$V1 %in% c(1:22))

sorted_bim <- bim[order(bim$V1, bim$V4), ]
identical(bim, sorted_bim)

positions_sorted <- all(unlist(lapply(split(bim, bim$V1), function(x) all(diff(x$V4) >= 0))))

if (!positions_sorted) {
  stop("Base-pair positions are not sorted within chromosomes.")
}


# Check for duplicate SNPs
duplicates <- bim[duplicated(bim$V2), ]
if (nrow(duplicates) > 0) {
  print("Duplicate SNPs detected:")
  print(duplicates)
}

duplicate_positions <- bim[duplicated(bim[, c("V1", "V4")]), ]
if (nrow(duplicate_positions) > 0) {
  print("Duplicate positions detected:")
  print(duplicate_positions)
}


bim[] <- lapply(bim, function(x) gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", x))

all.equal(bim[],bim)
identical(bim[],bim)

```
